description: The Chronicle and Legends (ChronicleManager.gd, LegendManager.gd): what the world remembers, epithets, epitaphs, and how your Legend is written and carried to new worlds.

fields.name: min_importance
fields.help: News at or above this importance is kept in the Chronicle.

fields.name: max_entries
fields.help: Cap; the least important, oldest entries go first.

fields.name: kind_importance
fields.help: News kind -> base importance (death, rival, rank, adventurer, guild, party, tavern, info, event, chronicle).

fields.name: boosts
fields.help: [{contains, add}]: extra importance when a line contains the text.

fields.name: epithets
fields.help: [{id, text, <deed>: minimum}] - the first whose every minimum is met. Deeds: crowns, bosses, deepest, firsts, kills, avenged, rescues, near_death, top_rank.

fields.name: epitaphs
fields.help: trait -> one line for the Fallen; 'default' otherwise.

fields.name: legend
fields.help: Legend writing: max_beats, templates (origin, deed, bond, rival, crowns, end, bard_intro) with {name} {race} {class} {year} {season} {friend} {rival} {rank} {epithet} {count} {text}; heir_chance, heir_drive, relic_chance, relic_rarity.
